question.prompt: In \(\triangle ABC\), \(AB=AC\), \(\angle BAC=120^\circ\), and \(AD\perp AB\), with \(AD\) intersecting \(BC\) at \(D\). If \(DC=4\), find the length of \(BC\).

solutions.explanation: \(\angle B=\angle C=30^\circ\), and \(\angle DAC=120^\circ-90^\circ=30^\circ=\angle C\), so \(AD=DC=4\). In right triangle \(ABD\), \(\angle B=30^\circ\), so \(BD=2AD=8\) and \(BC=8+4=12\).
solutions.title: Equal angles and a 30° right triangle
